records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Your webhook question + next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for flagging the webhook payload for the 'first_project' event — your ticket is open with Tariq and he's looking at it now. I'll keep an eye on it from my side too.

Since the kickoff, I noticed your project is set up but no teammates are in yet. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through the next step with you.

Best,
Priya
